subject: Implementation plan: no-train API + subprocessor disclosure for EuroTel
messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@eurotel.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@eurotel.com
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: EuroTel: confirmation required on no-train + subprocessor locations

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the call earlier. EuroTel is preparing the final DPA addendum and we need to confirm a few operational items before we sign:

1) No-train commitment: we require a binding no-training commitment scoped to production prompts/responses (not telemetry) and an attestation that no customer content is used for model training.
2) Subprocessor geography: we need a list of subprocessors and the physical locations where EuroTel customer data may be processed (region + country).
3) Cross-border transfers: EuroTel legal will only accept SCCs or an EEA-resident processor unless we have a documented risk assessment.

Can you provide: (a) a one-page attestation for the no-train commitment, (b) the current subprocessor list with host country for each, and (c) the proposed transfer mechanism (SCCs + internal controls)? We would like these by Monday to stay on track for 12/28 signature.

Attachments: none from our side.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Lee
Senior Procurement Manager, EuroTel

--
Note: this is sensitive procurement correspondence.

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:36:00 -05:00
Subject: Fwd: EuroTel: confirmation required on no-train + subprocessor locations

Team — forwarding EuroTel's ask. High priority: procurement wants the legal-ready artifacts by Monday. Quick plan below.

Key deliverables to prepare:
- Short legal attestation (no-train): statement + signature block from Redwood legal.
- Subprocessor spreadsheet with country column and processing purpose.
- SCCs + list of controls (KMS, region pinning, logging/audit access) summary page.

Aditya: can you run the subprocessor export and annotate locations? Also confirm whether Private deployments or Dedicated pools ever surface to EuroTel (we need to clarify what counts as "processing").
Grace: loop in Legal to draft attestation and check that the wording aligns to the DPA addendum (no model weights update, no gradient retention, no training datasets).
Jonas: can you check product options for customer KMS + EU-only hosting and provide quick bullets we can include in the transfer controls doc?

I propose we meet 09:00 Monday to finalize artifacts. If we can turn a one-page attestation + two attachments (map + subprocessors) into a DocuSign envelope, procurement can sign.

Thanks — Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

--- Forwarded message attached from Sarah Lee ---

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 07:18:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: EuroTel: subprocessor export + locations

Kimberly / Grace — exported the subprocessor ledger and annotated geographies. Highlights:

- Hosting: primary hosted workloads run in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 (AWS) for EU tenants; backups may replicate to eu-west-2 depending on customer config.
- Third-party services: monitoring (LogStash EU cluster, hosted in NL), metrics/analytics (partnered vendor in IE), model telemetry pipeline (redwood-owned infra in eu-west-1).
- GPU inference backend: our Dedicated pools for EU customers are provisioned in customer-chosen regions (we have options to pin to EU-only).

I attached a cleaned sheet 'subprocessor_list_v2.xlsx' with Country and Purpose columns. Also attached 'eurotel_map_of_data_flows.pdf' showing how requests flow (edge -> regional routing -> inference pool -> response) and where KV/prefix caching persists.

On the no-train attestation: from a runtime perspective we support a "no model improvement" mode where prompt/response payloads are excluded from any training pipelines; telemetry for debugging (aggregated metrics, timestamps) may be retained. We need Legal to frame this precisely.

Actionables:
- Grace: draft attestation with explicit scope: production prompt/response excluded, telemetry allowed for operational debugging, no persistent dataset creation.
- Jonas: confirm whether KMS + customer-managed keys can be scoped to EU-only key stores and that we can document HSM vendor (if requested).

Attachments: subprocessor_list_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), eurotel_map_of_data_flows.pdf (diagram)

-Aditya
Senior Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 12:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: draft attestation for EuroTel (no-train)

Thanks Aditya — I drafted a one-page attestation and an accompanying FAQ for procurement/legal to reduce back-and-forth. Key wording notes I included:

- "No-training commitment": Redwood attests that EuTel customer content submitted to production inference endpoints (prompts and generated responses) will not be used to update, fine-tune, or otherwise train models used in production or lab environments.
- "Scope": applies only to customer content routed to production inference endpoints under account E-4521. Telemetry and aggregated operational metrics are not covered by this clause but will be processed under standard DPA telemetry provisions.
- "Verification": we will provide the subprocessor list, data flow diagram, and SCCs; we can also provide logs showing inference endpoints were configured with no-collection flags for the customer account (pseudonymized).

I've attached: 1) attestation text (to be signed by Redwood Legal), 2) short FAQ for EuroTel procurement that explains what we mean by "no-training" and how it interacts with caching and model variant routing.

If legal approves, I'll add the signature block and we can send to Sarah.

Grace O'Connor
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@eurotel.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@eurotel.com, michael.gray@dpo-consult.com
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Implementation plan: no-train API + subprocessor disclosure for EuroTel

Kimberly / Redwood team — thanks for the quick turnaround and attachments. Procurement and Legal reviewed the attestation. A few follow-ups before we sign:

- Request for minor redline: change "telemetry and aggregated operational metrics" language to explicitly exclude raw prompts that are used for debugging unless redacted. Our legal wants: "telemetry limited to aggregated operational metrics, logs redacted of customer content; raw prompt payloads are excluded from telemetry unless specifically required for debugging and then redacted or provided under restricted access and retention."
- SCCs: please confirm you will execute the standard EU SCCs and provide signed copy via DocuSign link.
- Evidence: EuroTel requires evidence that the account E-4521 is configured with the no-collection flag — a short export or screenshot of the account settings and one sample audit log (redacted timestamps) is acceptable.

If you can return the attestation with the redline and the SCCs + the small evidence packet by Thursday EOD (EuroTel time), Procurement will schedule signature. If that's tight, let us know and we can push signature one week.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Lee
Senior Procurement Manager, EuroTel

Attachments referenced: none.

- Wednesday: signed SCCs sent via DocuSign (we will complete internal sign-off today).
- Wednesday: evidence packet — screenshot of account E-4521 settings (redacted), and one sample audit log with prompt content redacted.

We will deliver the attestation as a DocuSign-ready PDF and include the FAQ. If EuroTel needs a joint call to review the scoping language, we can do a 30-minute session Wednesday morning.

Thanks — Kimberly
